description: Causal Claim Referee — Referees a causal claim against an observational table (JSON rows, CSV text, or a published contingency table with counts) and leads with a verdict, confidence, whether the claim holds, the crude and adjusted effects with bootstrap intervals, and a concrete next step. Underneath: crude and stratified effects, Mantel-Haenszel pooling, Simpson's-paradox detection, d-separation and backdoor/front-doo

alpha.description: Significance level for the permutation test and the (1-alpha) bootstrap interval, default 0.05.

bins.description: Quantile bins for numeric covariates, default 4.

claim.description: The causal claim being refereed, in plain language.

claimDirection.description: Direction of the claimed effect of treated vs control; default nonzero.

countColumn.description: Name of a column holding how many times each row repeats, so a published contingency table can be sent as a few aggregate rows (counts must be non-negative integers; the expanded table is capped at the row limit).

covariates.description: Candidate adjustment variables (at most 12). Numeric ones with more than `bins` distinct values are cut at deterministic quantile edges; others must have at most 20 levels.

csv.description: Alternative to data: CSV text with a header line (comma, semicolon or tab separated; quoted fields allowed; at most 20000 data rows). Numeric cells become numbers.

dag.description: Your causal DAG (formal input: no LLM is called to build the graph or, by default, the report). Omit to have one proposed by two independent model samples, which is then an assumption.

edges.description: Directed edges from cause to effect between the treatment, outcome, covariates and unobserved nodes.

unobserved.description: Latent variables that appear in edges (for example an unmeasured confounder).

data.description: Observational table as an array of row objects (at most 20000 rows). Cells are string, number, boolean or null; rows missing a used variable are dropped. Provide this or csv.

descriptions.description: Optional one-line description per variable, used only to propose the DAG.

llmReport.description: Ask a model to write the executive report in prose (numbers verified in code, template fallback). Default false: the report is a deterministic template over the computed results.

outcome.description: Binary column (risk difference, risk ratio, odds ratio) or numeric column (mean difference).

outcomeType.description: Force the outcome type; inferred from the number of distinct values otherwise.

permutationSamples.description: Used only when the exact enumeration would exceed 1000000 label assignments.

seed.description: Seed for bootstrap and Monte Carlo; default derived from the input hash.

successValue.description: Outcome value that counts as success for a binary outcome; same default rule.

treatedValue.description: Treatment value that counts as treated; required unless the values are numeric or boolean (then the larger is treated).

treatment.description: Column with exactly two distinct values.

name: causalReferee
